result.qualitative: graph/lexical modes surfaced some cross-branch relational facts plain FTS missed; activation did not consistently outperform graph-lexical and sometimes added noise

experiments.interpretation: Reject current per-query activation implementation as hot-path superior; retain semantic graph hypothesis.
experiments.boundary: GitHub-runner timing and 8B proxy, not live FRANK/Qwen4B.

experiments.interpretation: A large fraction of current query cost can plausibly be implementation/indexing overhead rather than intrinsic graph traversal cost. Exact speedup does not transfer to the RAE corpus or FRANK.
experiments.falsifier: Actual current-corpus resident/indexed implementation fails to materially reduce p50/p95/p99 or introduces unacceptable update/memory cost.

experiments.interpretation: Even without optimizing graph execution, gating graph use to a minority of queries strongly reduces expected retrieval cost versus always-on graph. This is not an accuracy result and assumes current runner timings.
